decisions.statement: A page type is mortal only if the page type says so.
A non-mortal page cannot have a relation to a mortal page.
A mortal page naming a page that is not there is not refused for naming that page.
A name for a mortal page type is not refused for reaching no page.
A change is not refused for a fault a mortal page already had.
A change is refused for a fault that change puts into a mortal page.
Either exemption applies on its own.
Neither exemption waits on the other exemption.

definition: whether a page type's pages are expected to be deleted
